question: Dr. Sunanda Nair is recognised as a ___________ performer, teacher, and proponent.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mohiniyattam__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dr. Sunanda Nair **is** a Mohiniyattam performer, teacher, and proponent, who has gained high acclaim both in India and across its shores.**
 
• Dr.Sunanda Nair is the** first student in the country** to have a **Masters' degree in Mohini Attam from Nalanda Nritya Kala Mahavidyalaya affiliated with the University of Mumbai.**<
